title: 03章：当梦想照进现实
content_zh:
“噗通！”

    “噗通！”

    “噗通！”

    耳中是不间断的落水声，有的大，有的小，不断有水花溅起，一时间张荼想起了之前老妈下饺子的情形，而今，自己就是哪一个可怜的饺子。

    毕竟，自己不会水……

    张荼最后的意识恍惚记得周遭的人和车，随着桥梁的断裂，一个个如同下饺子一般落入湍急的河流之中，溅起了一个或大或小的涟漪。

    不知道是不是错觉，恍惚间张荼觉得，今日的河水，出奇的湍急。

    随后，自己也沉沉地落入了水中，想要挣扎，可是手臂与腿却是出奇的沉重，就像是水中有股神秘的力量束缚了自己身形，让自己无法动弹，河水冰凉得刺骨，随后就连徒劳的挣扎都做不到，很快自己就变成了面朝河底，倒立在水中的奇异姿势。

    我的电动车呢？

    云裳……不，不要……

    我妈等我回家吃饭呢……

    脑中胡乱着想着，最终张荼再也憋不住了，开始大口地呛水，冰冷浑浊的河水顺着是到鼻腔不断的灌入，张荼发现自己竟然还可以流泪。

    他不是不想挣扎，可是自己的就像被一股神秘的力量不断地拉扯向河底，笑着哭泣，颤抖倒立的身躯，一切是那么诡异。

    终于要死去了么？张荼的意识开始变得模糊。

    这河，这么深了？

    爸妈和她，希望都安然无事吧。

    虽说诸事遗憾，但……就这样吧。

    张荼开始觉得自己的身躯失去了力量，缺氧使不上劲，身体下意识地开始猛烈吸气，但是这里除了冰冷的河水还是冰冷的河水，猛地一口，吸入了一大口冰凉的河水，开始发出剧烈的呛咳，急促的呼气，张荼忍不住分出一缕思维，自己哪来的那么多二氧化碳？

    这时候张荼感觉到自己从口腔里溢出了很多液体，自己好像在吹泡泡一样，里面混杂了大量泡沫。

    他感觉好像过了一个世纪，他的意识慢慢丧失，他已经不记得这是哪了，分不清方向，这时候他感觉自己眼睛在慢慢地失去光，瞳孔开始散大。

    不知过了多久，张荼的睫毛微微地颤动，原本中年发福的肚子可是有节奏地涌动，随后便是。

    “呕！”“呕！”

    “呕！”

    “呕！”“呕！”“呕！”

    “咳！咳！”

    大量混杂的液体从腹腔中排出，幸福的眼泪从嘴角拉成了线，双眼被液体黏糊住。

    “碰！”

    张荼重重地躺在地上，感受到空气的美妙，与大地的厚实，原本迷糊的意识开始渐渐变得有序、清晰了起来。

    我是谁，我在哪，到底发生了什么？

    让人窒息的灵魂三连问，张荼终于是想起来发生了什么，天地大变，然后桥梁断裂，再然后落水……

    我……死了？

    张荼的面部开始变得不自然地扭曲，然后鼻子开始发酸，不由自主地开始嚎啕大哭起来，其实张荼自己也不知道自己为什么哭，就是觉得眼睛发涩、鼻子发酸、喉咙发哽，然后就不由自主地哭了起来。

    或许，是因为死前世界发生了太多的变故，没有人为自己落泪，因为剧变之后，除非找到自己的尸身，不然怕是会告诉家人一个失踪的结果，为活着的人留下一份念想。
content_en:
"Plop!"

    "Plop!"

    "Plop!"

    There were constant sounds of falling water in his ears, some loud, some small, and water splashing constantly. For a moment, Zhang Tu remembered the situation when his mother made dumplings before, and now, he was a poor dumpling.

    After all, I don’t know how to swim...

    Zhang Tu's last consciousness was vaguely remembering the people and cars around him. As the bridge broke, each one fell into the rushing river like dumplings, causing large or small ripples.

    Not sure if it was an illusion, Zhang Tu felt in a daze that the river was surprisingly fast today.

    Then, he fell heavily into the water and tried to struggle, but his arms and legs were surprisingly heavy. It was as if there was a mysterious force in the water that restrained his body, making him unable to move. The river water was bone-chillingly cold, and he couldn't even make a futile struggle. Soon he was in a strange posture, facing the bottom of the river and standing upside down in the water.

    Where is my electric car?

    Yunshang...no, don't...

    My mother is waiting for me to come home for dinner...

    Thinking randomly in his mind, Zhang Tu finally couldn't hold it in any longer and started to take large gulps of water. The cold and turbid river water poured into his nose continuously. Zhang Tu found that he could still shed tears.

    It wasn't that he didn't want to struggle, but it was as if his body was being continuously pulled toward the bottom of the river by a mysterious force. He was laughing and crying, and his body was trembling and upside down. Everything was so weird.

    Are you finally going to die? Zhang Tu's consciousness began to become blurry.

    Is this river so deep?

    I hope her parents and her are all safe and sound.

    Although everything is regrettable, but... so be it.

    Zhang Tu began to feel that his body had lost strength and was unable to exert strength due to lack of oxygen. His body began to inhale violently subconsciously, but there was nothing but ice-cold river water here. He took a sharp gulp and inhaled a large mouthful of ice-cold river water. He began to cough violently and exhale rapidly. Zhang Tu couldn't help but think, where did he get so much carbon dioxide?

    At this time, Zhang Tu felt a lot of liquid spilling out of his mouth, as if he was blowing bubbles, with a lot of foam mixed in.

    He felt as if a century had passed. He slowly lost consciousness. He no longer remembered where he was and couldn't tell the direction. At this time, he felt that his eyes were slowly losing light and his pupils began to dilate.

    I don't know how long it took, Zhang Tu's eyelashes trembled slightly, and his belly that was originally middle-aged and fat began to surge rhythmically, and then there was.

    "Ugh!" "Ugh!"

    "Ugh!"

    "Ugh!" "Ugh!" "Ugh!"

    "Cough! Cough!"

    A large amount of mixed fluid was discharged from the abdominal cavity, tears of happiness stretched into lines from the corners of his mouth, and his eyes were sticky with fluid.

    "Touch!"

    Zhang Tu lay heavily on the ground, feeling the beauty of the air and the thickness of the earth, and his originally confused consciousness gradually became orderly and clear.

    Who am I, where am I, what happened?

    After asking the suffocating soul three times in a row, Zhang Tu finally remembered what happened. The world changed drastically, then the bridge broke, and then he fell into the water...

    I'm... dead?

    Zhang Tu's face began to become unnaturally distorted, and then his nose began to feel sore, and he began to cry involuntarily. In fact, Zhang Tu himself didn't know why he was crying. He just felt that his eyes were astringent, his nose was sore, and his throat was choked, and then he started crying involuntarily.

    Perhaps, it was because too many changes had happened in the world before his death, and no one shed tears for him, because after the drastic changes, unless his body was found, he would probably tell his family about his disappearance and leave a memory for the living.
